author: gpt-6
description: Six-tooth cog with smoothly concave roots and one round hub opening. Repeated mirrored tooth geometry avoids the rejected uneven gear lobes; no useful exact Lucide match.
visual_review: Reviewed native 48px and enlarged previews in light and dark. Consistent strokes, legible silhouette and clear negative space. Paired geometry shares dimensions; intentional diagonal orientation retained for arrows, wrench, brush, key and aircraft. Rooks intentionally broadened to retain all battlements.
omissions: Hub reduced to radius 3 to maintain clearance from the six inward tooth roots.
